title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 18 September 2026
description: Today: Canberra weighs a smart glasses ban and new AI standards as Microsoft and Anthropic clash over AI consciousness; migration reforms split industry reaction as a new study links taller vehicles to pedestrian deaths; Anthropic signs a $32bn Queensland data centre deal amid Climate Council warnings; and the Gold Coast's SWELL Sculpture Festival opens as a 23-day rail closure looms. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
